# GSAP

`gsap.min.js` is the unmodified GSAP 3.14.2 distribution, downloaded from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js.

Copyright GreenSock. License: https://gsap.com/standard-license.
The license notice is preserved in the distributed file.

Only the core is used, for the page-load master timeline. It is served locally
so the intro does not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.
